question_text: Mr. Cruz, a municipal planning officer, was found guilty of violating RA 6713 for accepting a ₱50,000 gift from a contractor in exchange for expediting a building permit. The Ombudsman imposed a six-month suspension without pay. Which of the following statements best describes the legal effect of this administrative penalty on Mr. Cruz's potential criminal liability for the same act?

options.text: The administrative penalty bars any criminal prosecution because of double jeopardy.
The administrative penalty automatically reduces any criminal penalty by half.
The administrative penalty does not preclude criminal prosecution under the Revised Penal Code or other laws.
The administrative penalty must be fully served before any criminal case can be filed.
